newsitem.title: USA: Milwaukee NAPM fell to 56 in Nov from 60 in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Milwaukee NAPM fell to 56 in Nov from 60 in Oct.

text.p: Milwaukee's economic growth rate slowed in November, as the seasonally-adjusted Milwaukee National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index fell to 56 from 60 in October.
A reading af 50 indicates a neutral growth rate.

While the Milwaukee NAPM production component fell to 58, down three points, its prices paid index rose a point to 53. Prices paid for the regional NAPM have risen a point for the last five months. -Derivatives desk 312-408-8750;E-mail derivatives@reuters.com
